response.output: [architect] Prefer a modular monolith: clean layering (api/service/repository), extract microservices only for independently scaling parts; keep the domain model in one deployable to cut cross-service latency and ops cost.

[security] Top risks: 1) unvalidated file paths (path traversal) — enforce canonical+commonpath checks; 2) secrets in logs — redact before sink; 3) race on shared files — use O_NOFOLLOW and atomic os.replace; fail closed on any schema violation.
